message.content:
Add the "Continue with Google" button to the Nxeon `/register` page (it currently only appears on `/login`), then deploy staging→prod. Work in /opt/nxeon (Next.js + Prisma, this host). This is a small, well-scoped change — the exact edits are given below.

CONTEXT (verified): `components/AuthForms.tsx` already has a `GoogleButton({ next })` component (links to `/api/auth/google`) and `LoginForm({ next, googleEnabled, googleError })` renders it via `{googleEnabled ? <GoogleButton next={next} /> : null}` right after an `<ErrorBox error={googleError} />`. `RegisterForm()` currently takes NO props and renders NO Google button. `app/login/page.tsx` imports `googleOauthConfigured` from `@/lib/google-oauth`, reads `searchParams` (next/error), maps error codes to friendly copy, redirects already-signed-in users via `currentUser()`+`safeNext`, and passes `googleEnabled={googleOauthConfigured()}` + `googleError` + `next` into `LoginForm`. Google OAuth creates the account on first sign-in, so the same button doubles as sign-up on /register.

EDITS:
1. `components/AuthForms.tsx` — change `export function RegisterForm()` to accept `{ next, googleEnabled = false, googleError }: { next?: string; googleEnabled?: boolean; googleError?: string } = {}` and, at the top of its returned form (mirroring LoginForm), render `<ErrorBox error={googleError} />` and `{googleEnabled ? <GoogleButton next={next} /> : null}` (plus the same "or" divider LoginForm uses between the Google button and the email/password fields, if LoginForm has one — match LoginForm's exact structure/styling so register looks identical to login). Read LoginForm's JSX and replicate its Google section faithfully. Keep RegisterForm's existing fields/behavior otherwise.
2. `app/register/page.tsx` — mirror `app/login/page.tsx`'s structure: make it an async server component that awaits `searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string; error?: string }>`, import `googleOauthConfigured` from `@/lib/google-oauth` (and reuse the same GOOGLE_ERRORS friendly-copy map — copy it from login/page.tsx), compute `dest = safeNext(next)` and `googleError = error ? GOOGLE_ERRORS[error] : undefined`, redirect already-signed-in users (`currentUser()` → `/dashboard` or `/admin`) like login does, and pass `next={dest ?? undefined} googleEnabled={googleOauthConfigured()} googleError={googleError}` into `<RegisterForm />`. Keep the existing `<ReferralCapture />`, heading, sub, and bullets exactly as they are.

AFTER: `npx tsc --noEmit` (0 errors) + `npm run build` (fix issues). `git add` ONLY the two changed files (never `-A`, no secrets/scratch), commit (msg "Auth: add Google sign-in to /register (mirror /login)", Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>) — post-commit hook pushes to origin main. `bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh` (verify 200 on :8080), then `bash scripts/promote-production.sh` (verify prod 200 + nxeon-web active). Verify: `curl -s https://nxeon.cloud/register | grep -ic 'Continue with Google'` should be ≥1 (Google OAuth is configured on prod, since it shows on /login). 

CONSTRAINTS: only /opt/nxeon, only those two files (+ nothing else). Don't touch the .200/.215 boxes or other apps. Keep the live site working — if build/promote fails, don't leave prod broken; report. If a classifier blocks a command, report verbatim + stop.

Return: the two edits made, typecheck/build, staging + prod health, and the `/register` "Continue with Google" grep result.

All checks pass. Here's the report.

## Summary

Added "Continue with Google" to the Nxeon `/register` page, mirroring `/login`. All done and live.

### Edits (2 files only)

1. **`/opt/nxeon/components/AuthForms.tsx`** — `RegisterForm()` now accepts `{ next, googleEnabled = false, googleError }` (defaulting to `{}`). Its returned JSX is wrapped in a `<div className="space-y-4">` that renders `<ErrorBox error={googleError} />` then `{googleEnabled ? <GoogleButton next={next} /> : null}` above the form — identical structure/styling to `LoginForm`. The `GoogleButton` component already carries the "or" divider, so register looks the same as login. The form also emits the hidden `next` input like login. Existing fields/behavior unchanged.

2. **`/opt/nxeon/app/register/page.tsx`** — now an async server component awaiting `searchParams: Promise<{ next?; error? }>`. Imports `googleOauthConfigured`, `currentUser`, `safeNext`; copies login's `GOOGLE_ERRORS` map; computes `dest = safeNext(next ?? null)` and `googleError`; redirects signed-in users to `/admin` or `/dashboard`; passes `next={dest ?? undefined} googleEnabled={googleOauthConfigured()} googleError={googleError}` into `<RegisterForm />`. `<ReferralCapture />`, heading, sub, and bullets kept exactly as-is.

### Build / typecheck
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → 0 errors
- `npm run build` → success (exit 0)

### Commit / deploy
- Committed `881c2c0` (only the two files; post-commit hook pushed to origin main — confirmed `main...origin/main` in sync).
- `deploy-staging.sh` → staging HTTP 200 on :8080, both services active.
- `promote-production.sh` → production HTTP 200, both services active, `nxeon-web` active.

### Verification
- `curl -s https://nxeon.cloud/register | grep -ic 'Continue with Google'` → **1** (target ≥1 met). Prod `/login` also → 1; `/register` HTTP 200.
- Note: on staging both `/login` and `/register` grep to 0 — Google OAuth simply isn't configured there, so the button correctly hides (`googleEnabled` gate working as designed). It shows only where OAuth is configured (prod), which is the intended behavior. Live site is healthy.
